name: spidermon-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Spidermon, a framework for monitoring Scrapy spiders: monitors and
monitor suites run against a job's stats and settings when a spider opens, closes or periodically,
built-in monitors are configured through `SPIDERMON_*` settings, items can be validated with JSON
Schema in a pipeline, monitors can be written as Python expressions, stats history can be kept
between jobs, and actions send notifications and reports (email, Slack, Telegram, Discord, Amazon
SNS, Sentry, file reports and Scrapy Cloud job tags).

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the Spidermon package: every Python module under spidermon/, together with README.rst, the documentation pages docs/index.rst, docs/installation.rst, docs/getting-started.rst, docs/monitors.rst, docs/item-validation.rst, docs/expression-monitors.rst, docs/settings.rst, docs/actions/custom-action.rst, docs/actions/discord-action.rst, docs/actions/email-action.rst, docs/actions/file-report-action.rst, docs/actions/index.rst, docs/actions/job-tags-action.rst, docs/actions/sentry-action.rst, docs/actions/slack-action.rst, docs/actions/sns-action.rst, docs/actions/telegram-action.rst, docs/howto/index.rst, docs/howto/required-fields-coverage-validation.rst and docs/howto/stats-collection.rst, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.
